note: DSB only, as before: Hakrinbank's and Finabank's card terms weren't reached in this pass. De Surinaamsche Bank's information sheet (April 2025), read in full: the two cards it offers individuals, the DSB Classic and Gold Mastercard credit cards, in US dollars, with a membership of 50 and 60 dollars a year; a balance on which only the minimum is paid bears 1¼% in finance charges, written as a month's rate, the statement being monthly (paying in full costs nothing); the minimum payment is 4% of the balance outstanding; a cash advance or transfer from the card costs 2% of it, at least 5 dollars. The Corporate card, for businesses, isn't written. VAT is 0% on these charges unless stated. No grace period, late fee or foreign transaction fee is stated. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) added Hakrinbank, one of the country's three largest banks: its credit card page and its tariff list for 2025 (the latest it links), read in full: its Standard and Gold credit cards for private customers, in US dollars, at 14% a year; the annual fee from the tariff list, USD 50.00 for the Standard and USD 70.00 for the Gold (the card page's 'jaarlijkse bankprovisie' gives USD 40 and USD 60; the tariff list, the bank's price list, is written); the balance is repaid in full on the 28th of each month, or by the spread repayment, a twelfth of the balance each month, written as a minimum payment of 8.33% (a twelfth, rounded). The Business card isn't written. No grace period, late fee or foreign transaction fee is stated. Tried and not used: Finabank's site didn't answer and Republic Bank Suriname's home page links no card terms.
